needed.why: Read repositories, open and update pull requests, and push aico/task-* branches.
Import work items and move them forward as the task progresses.
Show the builds that gate a pull request.

warnings: Azure DevOps does not say what a token may write, so opening and merging pull requests is confirmed by the first one; a refusal names the missing permission.
Work items are unreadable with this token (it needs Work Items: read and write).
Build checks are unreadable with this token (it needs Build: read), so pull requests will show no build results.
Branch protection unreadable (branch policies need Code: read): AICO cannot see which reviews and builds main requires, so it will not offer to merge.
Sprints are unreadable with this token (it needs Project and Team: read).

mergeBlockers: The branch policies could not be read with this token, so AICO cannot tell whether they are met. Merge it on Azure DevOps.
